title: Power saving for prime-intersective polynomial differences
exact_target: For every h in Z[x] of degree at least two with positive leading coefficient and a unit root modulo every positive integer, do $c_h,C_h>0$ exist such that every A subset [N] avoiding the nonzero values h(p) for rational primes p as differences satisfies $|A|<=C_h$ $N^{1-c_h}$?
